title: E Numbers Decoded: What Those Codes On Your Food Labels Actually Mean
aiSummary: E numbers are not a warning label, they are Britain's system for tracking approved food additives. This guide decodes what the number prefixes actually mean, walks through the real evidence behind the Southampton Six colours, the widely misread aspartame cancer headline, the UK and EU's opposite rulings on titanium dioxide, and the quiet rise of emulsifiers in UK groceries, then gives four practical habits for reading a label without panic.
